info.name: Marketstack
info.description: **Easy-to-use REST API interface delivering worldwide stock market data in JSON format.** ## **Quickstart Guide** ### Step 1: Fork the collection To get started quickly, you need to fork the Marketstack Postman Collection. Simply click the button below to fork it. [](https://god.gw.postman.com/run-collection/10131015-9cbac391-3611-4f50-9bfd-d24ae41c97c1?action=collection/fork) ### Step 2: Get your API Access Key 1. Go to the [Marketstack](https://marketstack.com/?utm_source=Postman&utm_medium=Referral) website and choose the right subscription plan for your particular project. 2. Get your personal API Access Key on the [Dashboard](https://marketstack.com/dashboard) to authenticate with the API. Keep it safe! You can reset it at any time in your Account Dashboard. ## Step 3: Make your first API call Marketstack Postman collection contains all the endpoints supported by Marketstack API. 1. End-of-Day Data 2. Intraday Data 3. Real-Time Updates 4. Historical Data 5. Splits Data 6. Dividends Data 7. Tickers 8. Exchanges 9. Currencies 10. Timezones We recommend you to start with the End-of-Day Data endpoint as it's primary endpoint. It is used to obtain end-of-day data for one or multiple stock tickers. A single or multiple comma-separated ticker symbols are passed to the API using the symbols parameter.

item.description: Using the `tickers` endpoint you will be able to look up information about one or multiple stock ticker symbols as well as obtain end-of-day, real-time and intraday market data for single tickers.

item.name: Exchanges

request.description: Using the `exchanges` endpoint you will be able to look up information any of the 70+ stock exchanges supported by marketstack. You will be able to find and try out an example API request below.

response.name: 200 OK – Exchanges

query.description: [Required] Specify your API access key, available in your account dashboard.

item.description: Using the `exchanges` API endpoint you will be able to look up information any of the 70+ stock exchanges supported by marketstack. You will be able to find and try out an example API request below.

item.name: Currencies

request.description: Using the `currencies` endpoint you will be able to look up all currencies supported by the marketstack API. You will be able to find and try out an example API request below.

query.description: [Required] Specify your API access key, available in your account dashboard.

item.name: Timezones

query.description: [Required] Specify your API access key, available in your account dashboard.

Make sure to switch to Marketstack version 2 before 30th of June 2025. After that, all the endpoints in version 1 will not be supported by Marketstack API.

We have prepared a Migration Guide for you to switch to version 2 in literally no time.

Learn more about what's new in Marketstack version 2.

item.name: End-of-Day Data

query.description: [Required] Specify one or multiple comma-separated stock symbols (tickers) for your request, e.g. AAPL or AAPL,MSFT. Each symbol consumes one API request. Maximum: 100 symbols

request.description: You can use the API's `eod` endpoint in order to obtain end-of-day data for one or multiple stock tickers. A single or multiple comma-separated ticker symbols are passed to the API using the `symbols` parameter.

item.description: You can use the API's `eod` endpoint in order to obtain end-of-day data for one or multiple stock tickers. A single or multiple comma-separated ticker symbols are passed to the API using the `symbols` parameter.

item.name: Intraday Data

query.description: [Required] Specify one or multiple comma-separated stock symbols (tickers) for your request, e.g. AAPL or AAPL,MSFT. Each symbol consumes one API request. Maximum: 100 symbols

request.description: For customers with an active subscription to the Professional Plan, the marketstack API's `intraday` endpoint is also capable of providing real-time market data, updated every minute, every 5 minutes or every 10 minutes.

item.name: Real-Time Updates

query.description: [Required] Specify one or multiple comma-separated stock symbols (tickers) for your request, e.g. AAPL or AAPL,MSFT. Each symbol consumes one API request. Maximum: 100 symbols.
[Required] Specify the interval parameter and set it to 1min, 5min or 10min to obtain real-time data using this endpoint

request.description: For customers with an active subscription to the Professional Plan, the marketstack API's `intraday` endpoint is also capable of providing real-time market data, updated every minute, every 5 minutes or every 10 minutes.

item.name: Tickers

request.description:
Using the API's `tickers` endpoint you will be able to look up information about one or multiple stock ticker symbols as well as obtain end-of-day, real-time and intraday market data for single tickers. You will be able to find and try out an example API request below.

**Endpoint Features:**

| Object | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `/tickers/[symbol]` | Obtain information about a specific ticker symbol by attach it to your API request URL, e.g. `/tickers/AAPL`. |
| `/tickers/[symbol]/eod` | Obtain end-of-day data for a specific stock ticker by attaching `/eod` to your URL, e.g. `/tickers/AAPL/eod`. This route supports parameters of the [End-of-day Data](https://marketstack.portal.apilayer.ninja/documentation_v2#eod_data) endpoint. |
| `/tickers/[symbol]/splits` | Obtain end-of-day data for a specific stock ticker by attaching `/splits` to your URL, e.g. `/tickers/AAPL/splits`. This route supports parameters like date period `date_from` and `date_to` and also you can `sort the results DESC or ASC.` |
| `/tickers/[symbol]/dividends` | Obtain end-of-day data for a specific stock ticker by attaching `/dividends` to your URL, e.g. `/tickers/AAPL/dividends`. This route supports parameters like date period `date_from` and `date_to` and also you can `sort the results DESC or ASC.` |
| `/tickers/[symbol]/intraday` | Obtain real-time & intraday data for a specific stock ticker by attaching `/intraday` to your URL, e.g. `/tickers/AAPL/intraday`. This route supports parameters of the [Intraday Data](https://marketstack.portal.apilayer.ninja/documentation_v2#intraday_data) endpoint. |
| `/tickers/[symbol]/eod/[date]` | Specify a date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. You can also specify an exact time in ISO-8601 date format, e.g. `2020-05-21T00:00:00+0000`. Example: `/eod/2020-01-01` or `/intraday/2020-01-01` |
| `/tickers/[symbol]/eod/latest` | Obtain the latest end-of-day data for a given stock symbol. Example: `/tickers/AAPL/eod/latest` |
| `/tickers/[symbol]/intraday/latest` | Obtain the latest intraday data for a given stock symbol. Example: `/tickers/AAPL/intraday/latest` |

item.name: Bond List

request.description: The Bonds Listing API delivers the list of the supported countries data. API End points return the full list of supported countries.

response.name: 200 OK – Bond List

item.description: The Marketstack API users now have the possibility to call the `bondlist` endpoint from Marketstack to get a list of supported countries.

item.name: Bond Info

request.description: The Bond API delivers immediately real-time government bond data. The bond data focuses on treasury notes issued in leading countries worldwide for ten years. The Bond API delivers info for every country. API End points return the details for the desired country.

item.description: The new Bonds endpoint in Marketstack delivers real-time and historical bond market data tailored for requested countries. You can query bonds by country using the country parameter for precise results.

item.name: ETF Holdings List

request.description: The ETF Holdings API delivers instantly complete set of exchange-traded funds data based on the unique identifier code of an ETF data. API End points return the full list of supported ETF tickers.

item.description: The Marketstack users can now make a call to the `etflist` endpoint from Marketstack and the API will return a list of supported ETF tickers as a result.
